correctness.rationale: For positive three-type coupon probabilities the waiting-time tail inclusion-exclusion gives exact E[T] and E[T^2] as rational subset sums. At p=(a,(1-a)/2±delta) symmetry makes variance W(a,t) with t=bc=(1-a)^2/4-delta^2. Exact differentiation gives coefficient 32 Q(a)/(1-a^2)^4 and fourth-order coefficient 128 R(a)/(1-a^2)^6; the quartic is positive at the unique Q root. Q'(a) is strictly positive on (0,1/3), with opposite signs at a=0 and a=1/3; R>3 on [0.147,0.148] supplies critical positivity. Conditional common-species draws imply both common species appear more often when balanced and hence strictly smaller completion-time survival for every n>=3. Two-species variance z^-2-3z^-1-2 decreases with z=p1p2, proving minimal alphabet size. Independent exact SymPy calculation differentiated inclusion-exclusion moment rational functions and established both coefficient identities modulo Q; exact rational witness checked. All-real a result follows from analytic inequalities, not finite testing.
